dex.entry: The fully kindled water-light sprite — now a ghostly shining figure of pure tide-light that moves faster than the eye can track. The transcendent final form of the tiniest starter — trainers who raise a Tidmote are rewarded with the coast's most ethereal kin.

art.silhouette: Tall, translucent humanoid sprite of flowing water and moonlight — silver-white with luminous aqua veins, streaming ribbon-limbs, a face of pure calm radiance, and a cascading tail of moon-foam.
